in_arabic.name: Khuzaim
in_arabic.long_meaning: Khuzaim هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. A man who gathers wealth, knowledge or people. Derived from the name of Prophet Khizar (Khezr) in Islamic tradition.

in_urdu.name: Khuzaim
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Gatherer
in_urdu.long_meaning: Khuzaim ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ A man who gathers wealth, knowledge or people. Derived from the name of Prophet Khizar (Khezr) in Islamic tradition.

in_hindi.name: Khuzaim
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Gatherer
in_hindi.long_meaning: Khuzaim एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A man who gathers wealth, knowledge or people. Derived from the name of Prophet Khizar (Khezr) in Islamic tradition.

in_pashto.name: Khuzaim
in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Gatherer
in_pashto.long_meaning: Khuzaim یو اسلامي نوم دی چې په مسلم کلتور کې ژوره روحاني اهميت لري. A man who gathers wealth, knowledge or people. Derived from the name of Prophet Khizar (Khezr) in Islamic tradition.
